---
title: Manage Coupon
description: >-
  Monitor performance metrics, modify coupon details, and delete inactive
  promotions to keep your offers organized.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1374" height="759" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Incentive > Coupon List.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="244" height="147" style="width: 244px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Click a coupon to view details.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="522" height="234" style="width: 522px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3. Modify existing coupon content or delete coupon.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="408" height="204" style="width: 408px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
